name: Murals & More LLC
statement:
First of all, you’ve got to love the irony: Murals & More asking Murals & More to design and paint a mural project! Must be fate!

My name is Michael Cooper, and we are just starting our 37th year of designing and hand-painting custom interior and exterior murals, graphics and decorative finishes. We would be more than honored to work with you guys in designing and implementing what what should turn into quite the destination! My website is listed below - take your time as you examine our gallery. There’s quite a lot to look at!
